preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**12 for n in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case contains a positive integer n between 1 and 10^12.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) and result >= -1 for result in results)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is an integer greater than or equal to -1.

postconditions.expression: all(result == -1 or result > 0 for result in results)
postconditions.description: If a valid k exists, it is a positive integer; otherwise, the result is -1.

postconditions.expression: all(n == sum(distinct_powerful_numbers) for n, distinct_powerful_numbers in zip(test_cases, distinct_powerful_numbers_list))
postconditions.description: The sum of the distinct powerful numbers equals the input n for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(distinct_powerful_numbers)) == len(distinct_powerful_numbers) for distinct_powerful_numbers in distinct_powerful_numbers_list)
postconditions.description: The distinct powerful numbers are unique for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(all(is_powerful(number) for number in distinct_powerful_numbers) for distinct_powerful_numbers in distinct_powerful_numbers_list)
postconditions.description: All numbers in the distinct powerful numbers list are powerful for each test case.
